layout.title: Look
layout.description: How the events are laid out: a list, this week, or this month as a grid. Week and month need room: the card is 40 % wide unless you change it.
layout.help: List: the next events, day by day. Week: this week, Monday to Sunday. Month: this month as a grid, events over several days as bars. Want two looks? Add the module twice.

max_events.title: Max events
max_events.description: Maximum number of upcoming events to display (list look).

maximum_days.title: Days ahead
maximum_days.description: How many days in the future to search for upcoming events (list look).

recurring.title: Recurring events
recurring.description: Show a repeating event once, or at every time it happens.
recurring.help: Next only: a repeating event is shown once, at its next time, with how often it repeats. All: every time it happens gets its own row (list look).

url.title: ICS URL
url.description: HTTP URL to the public or private .ics file.

color.title: Indicator color
color.description: Hex color code or CSS custom property for event indicators (e.g., #ffffff, var(--color-ice-blue)).

icon.title: Lucide icon
icon.description: Lucide outline icon name to show next to events (e.g., calendar, music, alert-circle).

interval.title: Update interval
interval.description: Time to wait between calendar feed updates (e.g., 300 seconds = 5 minutes).
